description: This Java source file defines a database migration class 'Migration_20_21' for an Android app, handling schema changes from version 20 to 21. It includes methods to drop old indices, create new tables and indices, and migrate data between different schema formats during a database upgrade process.

classes.name: Migration_20_21
classes.description: A final class extending Room's Migration to handle database schema updates and data migrations between version 20 and 21 for the Nextcloud Notes Android client.
